summary: A fire on Line 2 at Shakti Components Pvt Ltd halted production on 2026-12-02. PO-1001 and PO-1002, totaling 6500 units of Bracket 501 due 2026-12-03 and 2026-12-04, are affected with INR 491400.00 at risk. Current inventory provides 1.5 days of coverage and both orders will face shortages. The biggest unknown is when the supplier will restart production.
facts: Shakti Components Pvt Ltd (SUP-1008) status is ACTIVE.
PO-1001 is OPEN with expected delivery 2026-12-03 for 4000 units of ITM-501 at INR 75.60 per unit, total amount INR 302400.00.
PO-1002 is OPEN with expected delivery 2026-12-04 for 2500 units of ITM-501 at INR 75.60 per unit, total amount INR 189000.00.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI: 800 units on hand, daily demand 150 units.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-PUNE: 1100 units on hand, daily demand 600 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2001 for ITM-501 is qualified with 2 days lead time, unit price INR 84.00, capacity 5000 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2002 for ITM-501 is qualified with 5 days lead time, unit price INR 79.50, capacity not provided.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 for 4000 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 2 days.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation: estimated_delay_days is 2 for PO-1001.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 for 2500 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 1 day.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation: estimated_delay_days is 1 for PO-1002.

estimates.statement: Current inventory provides 1.5 days of coverage for ITM-501.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation: inventory_coverage_days is 1.5 for both affected POs.

estimates.statement: Both PO-1001 and PO-1002 will result in shortages.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation: shortage is true for PO-1001 and PO-1002.

assumptions: The outage duration in the event is accurate.
The fire damage is limited to Line 2 and does not affect other production lines or inventory.
Daily demand rates for ITM-501 remain constant during the disruption period.
Alternate suppliers can be contacted and are willing to accept orders.
